t: Goldscrew multipurpose screws are essential fixings for various indoor projects. Ideal for carpenters, joiners, and general builders, these carbon steel woodscrews are perfect for securing timber frames, installing shelving, or general construction tasks. The wax-coated, zinc-plated and yellow-passivated finish provides corrosion resistance and ensures a lower screw-in torque for faster drive speeds, making installation efficient. A deep, sharp single thread cuts cleanly through wood, eliminating the need for pre-drilling. The double-countersunk head creates a flush finish, reducing shear and providing a neat appearance. This comprehensive 1400-piece multipack comes in a durable plastic organiser case, offering a range of mixed sizes for diverse applications, for use with screwdrivers, combi drills and impact drivers.
b: Deep, Sharp, Single Thread for Cutting Cleanly through Wood
No Pre-Drilling Required Saves Time & Effort
Multipack With Mixed Sizes For Versatile Use
